why: Mail scan, Tuesday 19:00 Jakarta: INSEAD Fontainebleau immigration mail

notes.itemTitle: Submit the visa application at TLS Contact
notes.title: INSEAD has a visa officer
notes.text: Amanda Heurteau runs French immigration for your intake at Fontainebleau and takes one-to-one calls through a booking link in her email. She says the long-stay visa can take seven to eight weeks, and your intake is 3 January. - A dossier stuck in Jakarta is exactly what that call is for.
